source_note: Aligned to Geiger–Marsden / Rutherford primary papers and textbook teaching anchors. Drafted from kaozheng ch1-rutherford; do not invent beyond cards.

cards.content: H. Geiger & E. Marsden, "On a Diffuse Reflection of the α-Particles," Proc. R. Soc. A 82 (1909) 495–500 (received 19 May, read 17 June 1909; communicated by E. Rutherford).
cards.content_zh: H. Geiger & E. Marsden，《论 α 粒子的漫反射》，Proc. R. Soc. A 82 (1909) 495–500。
cards.citation: Geiger & Marsden, Proc. R. Soc. A 82 (1909) 495–500

cards.content: Diffuse-reflection observations used a zinc-sulphide screen; scintillations counted with a low-power microscope. Method lineage includes Regener and Rutherford–Geiger 1908 counting work.
cards.content_zh: 漫反射观测采用硫化锌屏，用低倍显微镜计数闪烁。方法谱系包括 Regener 与 Rutherford–Geiger 1908 计数工作。
cards.citation: Geiger & Marsden 1909, p. 496; Rutherford & Geiger, Proc. R. Soc. A 81 (1908)

cards.content: 1909 apparatus hook: conical glass tube with radium emanation (radon), mica window at the tip; lead plate blocking the direct path; ZnS screen behind the lead so α cannot strike it directly; metal reflector near the tube mouth (~1 cm); count scintillations per unit area.
cards.content_zh: 1909 装置钩子：锥形玻璃管盛氡，末端云母窗；铅板挡住直达路径；ZnS 屏置于铅板后使 α 不能直接打上；金属反射体靠近管口（约 1 cm）；按面积计数闪烁。

cards.content: Some α particles are diffusely reflected — deflected through large angles, including paths that return toward the source side under the stated geometry — observed as ZnS scintillations.
cards.content_zh: 在所述几何下，部分 α 粒子发生漫反射——偏转很大角度，包括折向源一侧的路径——以 ZnS 闪烁观测。
cards.citation: Geiger & Marsden 1909 (title and body: diffuse reflection)

cards.content: In the broader Manchester α-scattering programme, the vast majority of α particles traversing thin foils continue nearly forward; large-angle events are rare. Teaching dialogue stresses this contrast with the rare diffuse reflections.
cards.content_zh: 在曼彻斯特 α 散射工作中，绝大多数穿过薄箔的 α 几乎沿前进方向继续；大角事件稀少。教学对话强调与稀有漫反射的对比。
cards.citation: Teaching synthesis from Geiger small-angle series + Geiger–Marsden large-angle reports; see also manchester.json mcr-1

cards.content: With layered gold, reflection rises then saturates (volume effect, not pure surface). Within a gold layer about 6×10^{-5} cm, some α can be turned through 90° or more.
cards.content_zh: 多层金箔反射随厚度增加后趋于饱和（体积效应而非纯表面）。在约 6×10^{-5} cm 金层内，部分 α 可转过 90° 乃至更大。

cards.content: With a RaC source and platinum reflector, Geiger & Marsden estimate roughly 1 in 8000 incident α are "reflected" under their stated assumptions (≈90° class, hemispherical uniformity assumption).
cards.content_zh: 用 RaC 源与铂反射体，Geiger & Marsden 在所述假定下估计约 1/8000 的入射 α 被「反射」（约 90° 量级，半球均匀分布假定）。

cards.content: E. Rutherford, "The Scattering of α and β Particles by Matter and the Structure of the Atom," Phil. Mag. 21 (1911) 669–688 (University of Manchester, April 1911).
cards.content_zh: E. Rutherford，《α、β 粒子被物质散射与原子结构》，Phil. Mag. 21 (1911) 669–688。

cards.content: Rutherford 1911 states that Geiger & Marsden's observations imply about 1 in 20000 α particles traversing gold foil ~0.00004 cm thick (≈1.6 mm air equivalent) are deflected on average through 90°.
cards.content_zh: Rutherford 1911 写明：按 Geiger & Marsden 观测，穿过约 0.00004 cm 厚金箔（约合 1.6 mm 空气阻止本领）时，约 1/20000 的 α 平均偏转达 90°。

cards.content: Rutherford hypothesizes a concentrated central charge ±Ne with compensating charge in a surrounding volume; large-angle deflections arise mainly from single scattering by a strong localized field, not compound scattering. The 1911 text does not banner the later word "nucleus".
cards.content_zh: Rutherford 假设集中的中心电荷 ±Ne，周围体积内有补偿电荷；大角偏转主要来自强局域场的单次散射，而非多次散射。1911 正文不以后世用语 nucleus 为旗号。

cards.content: Rutherford argues Thomson's diffuse positive sphere + compound-scattering expectations struggle to produce the observed large-angle probabilities unless the positive charge is concentrated in a region far smaller than the atomic radius of action.
cards.content_zh: Rutherford 指出：若正电弥散于原子作用半径量级，Thomson 式图像与多次散射概率律难以给出所观测的大角概率；除非正电高度集中。

cards.content: Modern textbook framing (e.g. 人教版选必三): nearly all mass and positive charge concentrated in a tiny centre; electrons outside; plum-pudding cannot explain the impossible large-angle events. Use as textbook-tier teaching language, distinct from 1909 lab diction.
cards.content_zh: 现代教材用语（如人教版选必三）：几乎全部质量与正电荷集中在很小的中心，电子在外围；枣糕模型解释不了那些大角偏转。作 textbook 层教学语，区别于 1909 实验室措辞。
cards.citation: 人教版选必三 第四§3–§4；manchester.json mcr-5

cards.content: Rutherford: laboratory head and theoretical framing. Geiger: senior experimenter, scintillation/counting methods. Marsden: undergraduate (Hatfield Scholar) assisting under Geiger on diffuse-reflection work. Rutherford is not the overnight scintillation slave.
cards.content_zh: 卢瑟福：实验室主任与理论框架。盖革：资深实验、闪烁/计数方法。马斯登：本科生（Hatfield Scholar）在盖革指导下参与漫反射。卢瑟福并非整夜数闪烁之人。
cards.citation: Geiger & Marsden 1909 authorship/acknowledgements; AIP Rutherford's Nuclear World; Eve, Rutherford (1939) letter re counting
